title: A Trump administration official says a "trivial" number of Nvidia's H200 chips were shipped to China after winning a US license, without offering specifics (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: A Trump administration official says a “trivial” number of Nvidia's H200 chips were shipped to China after winning a US license, without offering specifics — A small number of Nvidia Corp.'s H200 artificial intelligence chips have been shipped to customers in China after winning US approval …
